question: 26124 is a real German postcode (Oldenburg) that the engine's place gazetteer does not hold, so a real customer can reach C22's unknown-postcode answer.

gazetteer.checked: walk.mjs reads the gzip table and records record.json gazetteer.containsUnknown

sources.title: Über Oldenburg | Kommunales Immobilienportal
sources.description: Bundesland: Niedersachsen ; Landkreis: Oldenburg (Stadt) ; Postleitzahl: 26121, 26122, 26123, 26124, 26125, 26126...[+] ; Vorwahl *:. 0441 ; Einwohner: 163.830.

conclusion: Two independent directories list 26124 among Oldenburg's postcodes, Wikipedia's infobox gives Oldenburg's range as 26121-26135, and the IHK Oldenburg contact page at schulpraktikumsfinder.de also lists it. It is real, five digits, and absent from the gazetteer.
